notes:
Heal rules can now be marked Undead only. When you tick that on a Heal rule, the bot casts Heal at the Undead monster it is fighting whenever no defensive heal of yours is due, and the Combat page tells you in plain words why it is or is not firing: target not Undead, out of range, no line of sight, on cooldown, not on the hotbar, not enough resources, or the rule is off. Your defensive heals keep priority.

AUTO now moves once from the Dark Fortress entrance toward the farming area, then hands control to combat when it finds a valid monster.

AUTO now includes your Auto Attack when it chooses how close to walk, so a ranged character stops at a distance both its skill and its weapon can reach instead of closing further than it needs to.

An empty combat rotation is now kept as it is when your profile allows it or you have an Undead heal rule, instead of being replaced with the normal attack.

Improved TrueSight reliability when casting immediately after another spell.

Fixed TrueSight incorrectly stopping movement while its effect remained active.

Improved Corpse Barrier upkeep, including summon selection and avoiding unnecessary casts while its shield is active.

Endow Holy no longer recasts every few seconds after a confirmed successful cast.

Corrected unnecessary rotation delays for Chain Lightning, Tempest, Earthbolt and Firebolt when their actual casts finish sooner than expected.

Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
